dupont.reading: The decomposition is dominated by the equity multiplier, which is inflated because average equity is the mean of a year-ago deficit {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.stockholders_equity.value} and a small positive balance {terms.balances_now.stockholders_equity.value}. Net margin and asset turnover are the informative terms: a net margin of {ratios.profitability.dupont.net_margin.value} on turnover of {ratios.profitability.dupont.asset_turnover.value} gives return on assets {ratios.profitability.return_on_assets.value}, and return on invested capital {ratios.profitability.return_on_invested_capital.value} says the same thing without the leverage distortion. Leverage as measured by liabilities over assets {ratios.solvency.liabilities_over_assets.value} is still high for a manufacturer, so the multiplier will stay large even after equity normalizes.

path_to_distress.distance_today: far: debt over EBITDA {ratios.solvency.debt_over_ebitda.value}, interest coverage {ratios.solvency.interest_coverage.value}, no maturities in the coming fiscal year, an undrawn revolver and free cash flow simple {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple.value}
path_to_distress.trigger: a hard-drive demand pause of the kind in the calculator's trough year, when revenue fell {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.3.revenue_growth} and operating margin was {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.3.operating_margin}: hyperscale capital budgets slow, nearline pricing gives back the gains management calls structural, and the extra capacity built for HAMR is under-used
sequence: revenue and mix reverse: gross margin falls from {ratios.profitability.gross_margin.value} toward the trough-year level as fixed factory cost is spread over fewer exabytes and purchase-order cancellation fees reappear

working capital turns hostile: unconditional purchase obligations due within a year exceed inventory on hand, the supplier finance balance {terms.balances_now.supplier_finance_obligation.value} can be withdrawn by the banks, receivable concentration among three customers concentrates any payment delay, and work-in-process for new-technology drives is exposed to write-downs

cash calls that do not shrink with revenue keep coming: the dividend at the current rate against {terms.trailing_four_quarters.dividends_paid.value} paid this year, the securities settlement within a year, the export-control installments for several more years, the equipment commitments, and accrued taxes that will be paid

covenant math tightens: the net leverage ceiling steps down after the next fiscal year and now applies whether or not the revolver is drawn, and adjusted EBITDA is the denominator; at trough-year operating income {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.3.operating_income} today's debt {terms.debt_now.value} would sit against a very different multiple

the response tools, in order: cut repurchases, resume receivable factoring, draw the revolver, cut the dividend, defer capital spending within the commitments, and refinance the later-year maturities at coupons above the redeemed series
buffers: free cash flow simple stayed positive at {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.3.free_cash_flow_simple} in the loss year, and operating cash flow at {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.3.operating_cash_flow}
the maturity ladder has nothing due in the coming fiscal year and the highest-coupon series were retired after year-end
the revolver is undrawn and the year-end cash {terms.balances_now.cash.value} remains sizeable after the post-period redemptions
share-settled exchanges and a high share price {cost_of_capital.price_at_cutoff.value} make equity a cheap source of capital as long as the price holds
signals_to_watch: sequential revenue against the first-quarter guidance and any change in the data-center share of revenue
days sales outstanding {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_outstanding.value} and the receivable concentration table
work-in-process inventory and days of inventory {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_of_inventory.value}
the supplier finance roll-forward and days payable {ratios.efficiency.days_payables_outstanding.value}
purchase-order cancellation fees or factory underutilization charges in the non-GAAP reconciliation
the warranty roll-forward's changes in pre-existing warranties
resumption of receivable sales, revolver draws, or a pause in repurchases
the effective tax rate as incentives expire and top-up tax grows
path_to_distress.assessment: Distress within the forecast horizon requires a demand cycle at least as deep as the last one arriving while the company is still carrying the current dividend, the HAMR capital program and the post-redemption cash position. The record says the business generated cash through the last trough; the balance sheet is stronger now than then; the probability of financial distress is low, while the probability of a sharp earnings reversal is the ordinary condition of the industry.

limits: This analysis reads the company's health from its own filed numbers against its own past. It forecasts nothing, and it cannot see what is not in the filings.
